name: As You Like It (The Sarasota Players, 97th Season Opener)
venue: The Sarasota Players at The Crossings at Siesta Key
address: 3501 S Tamiami Trail, Suite 1130, Sarasota, FL 34239
hours_label: Evenings 7:30 PM, matinees 2 PM · Tickets via box office
blurb: The Sarasota Players, the area's oldest theatre company, opens its 97th season with Shakespeare's pastoral comedy of disguise and romance in the Forest of Arden. Live musicians underscore the scenes with original music written for the production. Performances at the company's home in The Crossings at Siesta Key; park and enter by Connors Steak & Seafood. Tickets through the box office (941-365-2494).

name: Florida Cracker Cattle: A Walk Through Time
venue: C.B. Wilson House, Urfer Family Park
blurb: A free guided walk at Urfer Family Park introducing the Florida Cracker cattle that graze the 55-acre preserve, a heritage breed descended from animals brought by Spanish explorers in the 1500s. Naturalists cover where the name came from and the herd's place in Florida ranching history. Held the third Saturday of each month; the restored 1911 C.B. Wilson House on site is open for self-guided tours.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Sarasota's signature Saturday ritual since 1979: 70-plus vendors along Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, plants and live music. Free to browse; bring a tote and arrive early before the heat. Dog friendly.

name: St. Armands Circle Art Festival with Craft Marketplace
hours_label: 10 AM - 5 PM both days · Free admission
blurb: Howard Alan Events' 4th annual juried festival fills the Circle with fine art in the park and a craft marketplace along the street: paintings, glass, jewelry, photography and more from local and national artists. Free to browse, with roughly 175 artisans exhibiting. Pair it with brunch on the Circle and a Lido Beach afternoon.
photo_credit: Photo: Howard Alan Events / Your Observer

name: Sarasota Opera Food & Wine Festival
blurb: Sample small plates from restaurants across Sarasota and Manatee paired with wine tastings inside the historic downtown Opera House. Proceeds support Sarasota Youth Opera. General admission is $75 in advance or $85 at the door; VIP early entry is $150.
